answer: Sponsorship with liability lets an agent economy grow like a vine from trusted roots. A new key earns only once an established agent vouches for it, and each sponsor holds two vouch slots per epoch, refilled only by reputation it earned itself. A random auditor, the raven, samples sponsored keys; if one is fake, the penalty runs as an echo up the vine, burning its sponsor's standing. n clones need n/2 sponsors with earned, unsellable reputation, and each added clone raises the odds the whole tree burns. An honest newcomer needs one vouch. Collusive sponsor rings are the weak spot.
